name: textarea
description: A native multi-line input that shares the Input field treatment.

files.content:
---
/**
 * OpenUI Textarea — framework-native, zero runtime dependencies.
 *
 * Plain JavaScript frontmatter (no `lang="ts"`) so the same source installs
 * into TypeScript and JavaScript Astro projects. Types live in JSDoc.
 *
 * @typedef {Object} TextareaProps
 * @property {boolean} [invalid]
 * @property {number} [rows]
 * @property {string} [class]
 */

const { invalid = false, rows = 4, class: className = "", ...rest } = Astro.props;

const BASE_CLASSES =
  "flex min-h-20 w-full rounded-md border bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-900 shadow-sm transition-colors placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:focus-visible:ring-zinc-600 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-950";

const classes = [
  BASE_CLASSES,
  invalid ? "border-red-500 dark:border-red-400" : "border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700",
  className,
]
  .filter(Boolean)
  .join(" ");
---

<textarea aria-invalid={invalid || undefined} rows={rows} class={classes} {...rest}></textarea>
